verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog says Guided Reviews "break diffs into focused sections with explainers on what changed and why," which matches the story almost word for word. Other entries show code review and diff rendering inside Linear and its mobile app, but the core claim rests on a single changelog line. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how Guided Reviews generates sections and explanations (scope, accuracy, which diffs it covers), and independent or hands-on corroboration that it works as described.
